query: AMD fiscal year 2026 Q1 revenue breakdown data center AI
normalized: 2026 ai amd breakdown center data fiscal q1 revenue year

output.content:
AMD’s **Q1 FY2026 (quarter ended March 28, 2026)** revenue was **$10.253 billion**, up **38% year over year** and essentially flat versus Q4 FY2025. [[1]]

**Data Center / AI breakdown**

| Revenue category | Q1 FY2026 revenue | YoY growth | QoQ change / context |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Data Center segment | **$5.775bn** | **57%** | Up from $5.380bn in Q4 FY2025, or about **7% sequentially**. [[1]]|
| Server CPUs | Not separately disclosed | Management reported its fourth consecutive quarter of record server-CPU revenue; growth reflected EPYC demand. [[2]]|
| Data-center AI / Instinct GPUs | Not separately disclosed | Continued ramp in Instinct GPU shipments supported segment growth. [[1]]|
| Data-center AI QoQ | Not separately disclosed | AI revenue was down modestly sequentially, principally because China revenue was lower following the China transition. [[2]]|

The key limitation is that AMD **does not report a dollar figure separating Instinct/data-center AI GPU revenue from EPYC server-CPU revenue** in its Q1 FY2026 segment disclosure; the reported Data Center total combines those businesses. [[1]] 

Data Center represented approximately **56.3% of consolidated Q1 revenue** ($5.775bn out of $10.253bn), making it AMD’s largest reported revenue segment. [[1]] 

For context, the rest of Q1 revenue comprised **Client $2.885bn**, **Gaming $720m**, and **Embedded $873m**; Client plus Gaming totaled **$3.605bn**. [[1]] 

Management’s near-term read-through was constructive: it guided Q2 FY2026 total revenue to approximately **$11.2bn ± $300m** and said both server and data-center AI revenue should grow **double digit sequentially**. [[2]]
